svg.title: Achievements
svg.desc: Prakalp 2026 · Winner. Ramachandra Engineering College, Eluru. First place for an automated SOC threat-detection solution. Smart India Hackathon 2025 · National Finalist. Smart India Hackathon. Selected nationally for AyuSetu, a blockchain platform that records supply chain provenance end to end. E-Summit 2026 · Winner. VIT Bhimavaram. First place for innovation in decentralized system architectures. ICRCESM 2025 · Research publication. International conference paper. Published a research paper on food redistribution technology platforms. Executive Body Member · 2025 - Present. Association of Computer Engineers. Organized 5+ technical hackathons and workshops that engaged 200+ students across campus.
